  • Certo VoiceFlow

    Certo's planned voice and typed search of the VistA record: a fixed grammar and no language model, so the same question on the same record always gives VistA's own answer. The product specification, the market research, the voice flow screen by screen, Certo as built, and the integration strategy. Not yet built.
